title: Get started with Lynch
text: lynch_palette() returns palette name. Printing draws colours.  Ask fewer colours n. Discrete palettes five colours, n can five.  Sequential diverging ramps interpolated, give number colours.   result keeps palette class printing. Use unclass() want plain character vector.
code: lynch_palette("twin_peaks") lynch_palette("blue_velvet", 3) lynch_palette("dune", 12, type = "sequential") lynch_palette("mulholland_drive", type = "diverging") unclass(lynch_palette("wild_at_heart")) #> [1] "#CD5C90" "#E5BF5C" "#73364F" "#9F8A5A" "#515767" #> attr(,"name") #> [1] "wild_at_heart"

title: Get started with Lynch
text: six film palettes five colour-blind-safe versions. Use scale_colour_lynch_d() scale_fill_lynch_d() categories.  Reverse order direction = -1. data categories palette colours, extra levels drawn NA get warning.
code: names(lynch_palettes) #>  [1] "blue_velvet"           "dune"                  "lost_highway"          #>  [4] "mulholland_drive"      "twin_peaks"            "wild_at_heart"         #>  [7] "blue_velvet_safe"      "dune_safe"             "mulholland_drive_safe" #> [10] "twin_peaks_safe"       "wild_at_heart_safe" ggplot(mpg, aes(class, fill = drv)) +   geom_bar() +   scale_fill_lynch_d("lost_highway") +   theme_minimal()

title: Get started with Lynch
text: film palettes, lost_highway keeps every colour distinct red-green colour blindness. _safe palette keeps three four colours film’s palette . lynch_accessibility test results. Use _safe palette four groups fewer.
code: lynch_accessibility[, c("palette", "n_colours", "deutan", "protan", "rating")] #>                  palette n_colours deutan protan                     rating #> 1            blue_velvet         5    8.5    6.7 close pair for all viewers #> 2                   dune         5    8.1    9.2 close pair for all viewers #> 3           lost_highway         5   15.1   13.2          colour-blind safe #> 4       mulholland_drive         5   10.1    8.8 close pair for all viewers #> 5             twin_peaks         5    1.2   14.2      not colour-blind safe #> 6          wild_at_heart         5    4.2    7.8 close pair for all viewers #> 7       blue_velvet_safe         4   17.2   18.1          colour-blind safe #> 8              dune_safe         4   17.5   11.2          colour-blind safe #> 9  mulholland_drive_safe         4   12.9    8.8          colour-blind safe #> 10       twin_peaks_safe         3   14.5   23.9          colour-blind safe #> 11    wild_at_heart_safe         3   21.3   18.5          colour-blind safe ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +   geom_point(size = 3) +   scale_colour_lynch_d("twin_peaks_safe", name = "Cylinders") +   theme_minimal()

title: Get started with Lynch
text: scale_colour_lynch_c() scale_fill_lynch_c() map numbers ramp. default sequential.  values either side reference point, use type = "diverging" set midpoint. Without midpoint, grey centre sits halfway across data range.  four films diverging ramps:
code: ggplot(faithfuld, aes(waiting, eruptions, fill = density)) +   geom_raster() +   scale_fill_lynch_c("dune") +   theme_minimal() df <- data.frame(   year = 2001:2020,   change = c(-4, -3, -3, -1, 0, 1, -2, 2, 3, 1, 4, 5, 3, 6, 8, 7, 9, 12, 10, 14) )  ggplot(df, aes(year, change, fill = change)) +   geom_col() +   scale_fill_lynch_c("mulholland_drive", type = "diverging", midpoint = 0) +   theme_minimal() names(lynch_diverging) #> [1] "blue_velvet"      "mulholland_drive" "twin_peaks"       "wild_at_heart"

title: Lynch scales for ggplot2 — scale_colour_lynch_d
text: palette Name palette. discrete scales, name names(lynch_palettes); _safe palettes stay distinct red-green colour blindness. continuous scales, name names(lynch_sequential) names(lynch_diverging), depending type. direction 1 palette's order, -1 reverse . ... arguments passed ggplot2::discrete_scale() ggplot2::continuous_scale(), name, labels na.value. type "sequential" ordered values, "diverging" values either side midpoint. midpoint continuous scales, data value put centre ramp, 0 diverging scale. NULL spans data range. guide continuous scales, legend: "colourbar" (default), "legend" "none".

title: Lynch 0.4.0

title: Lynch 0.3.0
text: Colour-blind-safe variants five palettes: blue_velvet_safe, dune_safe, mulholland_drive_safe, twin_peaks_safe wild_at_heart_safe. keeps three four colours film’s palette stay distinct red-green colour blindness. lost_highway already passes . New sequential ramps (lynch_sequential, one per film) diverging ramps (lynch_diverging, four films). lynch_palette() gains type = "sequential" type = "diverging" interpolates ramps n. New lynch_accessibility: colour-blindness test results every discrete palette.
